name: Fragment Swarm
desc:
A swarm of Threat fragments roils around the ship, providing a regenerating supply of fragments for fragment-based weapons.

As cargo size rises, more supplies are made available to the fragments, causing replacements to be launched proportionally faster.

This hullmod is required for fragment weapons to function, if the hullmod is not present or there are not enough fragments in the swarm, fragment weapons will be disabled.

Only made operational shortly before combat. If built-in, acts as an exceptional salvage gantry if one is willing to brave the risks of keeping the machinery running.
short: A swarm of Threat fragments roils around the ship.
sModDesc: Reduces maximum combat readiness by %s and increases the maintenance cost by %s. Acts as a Salvage Gantry with 4x efficiency.
